text: This program offers systematic and progressive Chinese classes which is available to Chinese learners at different levels. The program is for those who wish to enhance their Chinese progressively to a relatively high level with solid foundation. Elementary A: For beginners who has limited knowledge about Pinyin and Chinese; Elementary B: For those with basic Chinese and are able to express themselves in simple Chinese. Intermediate A: For those with basic language skills and are able to have simple conversations on general topics in Chinese Intermediate B: For those who are able to have discussions on general topics in Chinese. Advanced A: For those who understand Chinese news, and are able to fully express themselves in standard Chinese Advanced B: For those who understand Chinese news and contemporary literatures, and are able to fully express themselves in sophisticated Chinese.
